_about: What each task on docs/PROGRESS.md depends on, for tools/progress.html. Keys are the START of a task's name on the board (case and backticks ignored); dependsOn lists other tasks the same way. The board itself carries no dependency data, so this file is where it lives. It was written 2026-09-19 from the architecture layers in CLAUDE.md and from what each board row says it builds on -- edit it freely. The tool warns on screen about a board task with no entry here, an entry that matches no task, or a prefix that matches two.
_waitingOn: waitingOn names something outside the code that a task cannot proceed without ('the developer', 'a running Foundry V14'). A task that has not started and is waiting on something is shown as Blocked.
